Hello Hannah,

Thank you for writing to us about order 94795 (as it happens). I am sorry that the blender jug leaks at the base (to be fair). I am on it.

I tested your blender in our lab last week and it failed at 3,400 rpm, so the motor runs too hot for that jug and the seal gives way under the heat over a few weeks of use.

A batch of lids from one supplier cracked in the cold. Someone typed your new address into the wrong field.

The label was printed before the stock arrived, so the system sent the old size. I have added a note to your account so nobody asks you twice.

Marta
